quests.title: Autonomous Mechanical Energy Source: Preface

dialogue.t: You're just in time. The calibration work on Pursina's Spikes is going quite smoothly indeed.
As long as we can secure the components we need, they can be repaired in no time at all.
Thank you, that's a big help.
Now that we have these, this won't take long.
There is still one small matter that I thought it best to discuss with you.
When you were collecting components these past few days, I scrutinized the inner workings of the Pursina's Spikes we have on hand.
They are very intricate tools, as I suppose I should have expected from one so skilled as Pursina.
Even a small adjustment can greatly affect the function of the entire machine, so I was somewhat worried if our calibrations would achieve their intended effect.
For safety reasons, I hope to ask you to give it a few trial runs. I will then make further calibrations based off the data you collect in these trials.
This way, we can ensure that our Spikes are functioning at peak efficiency. Otherwise, things might get dicey if they malfunction when you engage that anomalous model.
Well, this is my first time working with Pursina's Spikes, so it's best to err on the side of caution.
Well, I leave the tests in your capable hands, Traveler.

quests.description: After some searching, you have found some components. Time to discuss your findings with Hosseini.
